entries.note: ref_type=code_immediate is a SECTION-LEVEL default per the source file's own prose statement, not individually chain_refs-verified per entry. Voice J (Kansai). Speaker split from a single collapsed "Villager (hint NPC)" label into distinct voice clusters (heuristic classification by speech-pattern markers - sentence-ending particles/dialect tics - not exhaustively linguist-verified; the 2 unlabeled generic groups did not show a strong enough marker to split further with confidence). Corrected 2026-09-02 during registry consolidation. CONSISTENCY FIX 2026-09-03 (term '熟練度'): 熟練度 is a formally-defined, named job stat (5 ranks, raises salary, persists across job changes - see the help-manual page 0x4eb040, which uses highlight markup and the capitalized 'Proficiency' 5 times while formally introducing the mechanic) and appears the same way in the battle-system level-up message (0x457db0: "'s proficiency rose to..."). 4 of 6 occurrences, all in casual/dialect NPC advice dialogue, paraphrased the same mechanic as 'skill'/'skill level(s)' instead (0x4859f0 Osaka-dialect, 0x485ef0 アル-dialect, 0x4862f0, 0x487290). No note documents this as deliberate - it reads as a synonym drift in casual paraphrase rather than a reasoned split (unlike e.g. the documented 死神 Doom/Reaper split elsewhere in the audit). Realigned the 4 casual lines to 'Proficiency' so the same underlying stat reads as the same name in dialogue, the help page, and battle messages, while keeping each line's dialect flavor intact.

entries.jp: 大神殿最深部マス
entries.note: matches "the Grand Temple of Mu" naming used throughout the dungeon-label entries below. CONSISTENCY FIX 2026-09-03 (term '大神殿最深部'): KNOWN CASE, investigated per owner's specific instruction (do not default to majority-wins blindly). This entry's own note claims deliberate reasoning: "matches 'the Grand Temple of Mu' naming used throughout the dungeon-label entries below." Verified this claim against the actual dungeon-label family and found it does NOT hold up: (1) entries whose JP explicitly writes ムー大神殿 (with Mu) consistently render 'the Grand Temple of Mu' (0x52f670, 0x4e92d0, 0x4e9e70, 0x4ec660, 0x538a60 'Grand Temple of Mu Entrance', 0x538d70 'Grand Temple of Mu Exit'); (2) entries whose JP is the bare/elliptical form WITHOUT ムー (大神殿入口, 大神殿内部, 大神殿最深部 - 15 entries total across all three) consistently drop BOTH 'Grand' and 'Mu', rendering just 'the Temple Entrance' / 'the Temple Interior' / 'the/To the Temple Depths'. This entry's own JP (大神殿最深部マス, no ムー) is the bare form. The exact sibling pattern - a マス-suffixed panel-label built on the bare form - already exists at 0x538fd0 (大神殿入口マス -> 'Temple Entrance Panel', NOT 'Grand Temple of Mu Entrance Panel'), which directly confirms the マス-panel-label form should also drop 'Grand'/'Mu'. Conclusion: the note's stated justification rests on a mistaken premise about what 'the dungeon-label entries below' actually do, so the EXCEPTION clause (preserve documented deliberate choices) does not apply here - the note documents a REASON, not a verified-correct one, and checking it was exactly what was asked. Realigned to 'Temple Depths Panel', matching both the 5-entry 大神殿最深部 majority and the 0x538fd0 sibling precedent.

entries.note: Navi-intro pool box F12. Spoken AFTER character creation completes (teleport flavor text). RESOLVED 2026-09-01: a genuine two-way branch at 0x367d18 (bne) selects between showing F12 or F13 via the SAME shared jal 0x3634a0 display call (the standard, already-proven-working path) - confirmed by manual control-flow trace, independently correcting a discovering agent draft that attributed the wrong lui (0x367d20, which only executes on F13-branch-not-taken path) to F12; the correct pairing is lui $a1,0x4f @0x367d1c (the UNCONDITIONAL delay-slot lui, which is the only lui that executes on the branch-TAKEN/F12 path) + addiu $a1,$a1,0x250 @0x367d2c. Both source lui instructions happen to encode the identical hi16 (0x4f), which is why the wrong attribution still computed the numerically correct address despite pointing at the wrong instruction - a real hazard for actual patching (editing the wrong lui would silently corrupt F13 instead of fixing F12). See skills/PATCH-MOD-ISO.md for the general branch-pairing-attribution gotcha this represents. REGISTRY WRITE-BACK GAP FIXED 2026-09-08 (4th confirmed instance of this bookkeeping-gap class, same as 0x5345c6/0x4f0220/the 2026-09-08 patched_diverged triage's 64 entries - see docs/planning-log/sentinel-bypass-loop-state.json's registry_bookkeeping_gaps_found_2026-09-07 note and docs/planning-log/2026-09-08-patched-diverged-triage.md's 'Still open' section): this entry was ALREADY on disc, sentinel-migrated, before this session started, but status/landing_vma/en never got written back to the registry. Markup-stripped normalize-compare (spk tags/|///removed) against the pre-fix registered en: 0 word differences - only the |/// line-and-page-break placement differed (the disc's real, in-game line-wrap vs. this entry's hand-authored draft wrap), same markup-only divergence class as every other confirmed instance. en updated to the fresh, byte-verified disc content below (matches player-visible on-disc rendering exactly); jp left untouched (already correct, no divergence found there). Pure registry-data correction, no ISO write - per GOAL.md's own rule this class of fix needs no PCSX2, independent re-derivation from raw bytes stands in for a second reviewer. Also fixed a pre-existing trailing-'//' omission in jp (the hand-authored jp was missing the final page-break marker present on the real original.iso bytes at this same id VMA, independently re-decoded via tools/dialog_codec.py - confirmed the disc stream really does end glyphs -> PAGE -> END, not glyphs -> END).

entries.jp: 魔法使い
entries.note: 魔法使い. BUG FOUND+FIXED 2026-09-07 (tools/apply_mage_pointer_fix.py): both ref-sites (0x473db0, 0x473ddc) held a plain (non-sentinel, 'generic'-path) pointer value 0x5345d0 - 2 bytes / 1 glyph-word PAST the real text start, landing on 'a' and silently dropping the leading 'M' (rendered as 'age' in-game). The full, correct 'Mage' text (M,a,g,e,<END>, 10 bytes) was already present and correctly written on disc at 0x5345ce the whole time - this was a pointer-value bug in an earlier, unrelated migration pass, not a content/encoding bug and not related to the sentinel-bypass mechanism at all. Fix: both ref-sites corrected 0x5345d0 -> 0x5345ce. 2 independent fresh adversarial reviewers confirmed SAFE TO APPLY before the write; applied, post-write readback confirmed, idempotent. LIVE PINE-VERIFIED 2026-09-07 (hero-1-only navigation, replicating the earlier successful slot1 pass, avoiding hero-2 recruitment entirely): job-select screen renders 'Mage' fully and correctly (not 'age', no clipping) in slot 2 of 4. See docs/planning-log/2026-09-07-colorselect-texture-investigation-jobselect-rootcause.md's '2026-09-07 (Bugs A/B live verification)' section.

entries.jp: ドカポン王国では、お金は力を持っておる。//たくさんお金を集めれば、|それだけ強い力を持てるということじゃ。//そして、この城にある金庫も|また不思議な力を持っておる。//その金庫は、女神さまが「お金を大事にしなさいよ」|という教えを込めて、|我が先祖にくださったのじゃ。//その名を世界平和金庫と言うのじゃ!//ウソでは無いぞ!//金庫にお金がたくさん入っている限り、|世界の平和は約束されるのじゃ!//
entries.en: In Dokapon Kingdom,|gold is power.//The more gold you|gather, the greater|your power.//And the vault in this|castle also holds a|strange power.//The Goddess gave it to|my ancestors, saying,|'Cherish your gold.'//It is called the {{HL:0xb002}}World|Peace Bank{{HL:0xb008}}!//I speak no lies!//As long as the bank is|full of gold, world|peace is guaranteed!//

entries.jp: たのんだぞ、勇者達よ!|早くマコンデを倒し、|世界平和金庫に金を戻してくれ!//だが、金庫に金を入れるのはもちろん、|現金をたくさん集めたり、多くの村を統治するなど、|ともかく多くの資産を集めるのじゃ!//このドカポン王国では金を持つ者がもっともえらい!|一番多くの金を集めた勇者こそ、|伝説のドカポンヒーローになるであろう!//
entries.en: I am counting on you,|heroes! Beat {{HL:0xb001}}Makonde{{HL:0xb008}}|quickly!//{{HL:0xb002}}Return the gold to the|World Peace Bank!{{HL:0xb008}}//Filling the vault is a|given, but amass cash,|rule many villages...//Gather assets any way|you can!//In this kingdom, those|with gold are the most|honored!//The legendary Dokapon|Hero will be whoever|has the most gold!//

entries.note: story p2; 67 words

entries.jp: そうしたいのは山々なのですが、|いろいろと大変なのです~。//ヨーロッパエリアは、|レッドブリキンという剣士に|支配されています~。//彼は強く、そして優しい、|すばらしい剣士でした~。//それが、あのいまわしい事件が|起きた日から、|変わってしまったのです~。//
entries.en: I'd truly like to, but|things are so hard~//The Europe Area is|ruled by a swordsman|named {{HL:0xb001}}Red Brikin{{HL:0xb008}}~//He was strong, kind...|a splendid swordsman~//But ever since the day|that dreadful incident|happened, he changed~//
entries.note: story p4; 218 words

entries.jp: あの事件?|むむ、なんだか|ミステリーっぽいですぅ・・・。//
entries.en: That incident?|Hmm... this sounds|like a mystery...//
entries.note: story p1; 54 words

entries.jp: レッドブリキンは、たまたま出会った|ヌイグルミをだいた少女に、|一目ぼれしてしまったのです~。//
entries.en: {{HL:0xb001}}Red Brikin{{HL:0xb008}} chanced on|a girl hugging a plush|toy, and fell for her~//
entries.note: story p1; 72 words

entries.jp: な~んだ、そんなことですか。|でも、それのどこが|事件なんですか?//
entries.en: Aw, is that all?|But how is that an|<000d>incident<000d>?//
entries.note: story p1; 50 words

entries.jp: 彼がしつこく|つきまとったのでしょうか・・・。//その女の子にコテンパンに|やられてしまったのです~。//そして、その時のケガで|天にめされてしまいました~。//
entries.en: Perhaps he pestered|her too much...//The girl beat him|black and blue~//And the wounds from|that day sent him up|to heaven~//
entries.note: story p3; 124 words

entries.jp: ええ!?死んじゃったんですか?//・・・その人、|本当に強かったんですか~?//
entries.en: Whaaat!? He died?!//...Was that guy|really that strong?//
entries.note: story p2; 57 words

entries.jp: どうやら、その女の子は人間では|なかったようなのですが~・・・。//問題はその後なのです~。//あまりの無念のため、彼は成仏|できませんでした~。//霊となった彼は、|ヨロイにとりついて、|現世に残ったのです~。//そして、女の子にふくしゅうするため、|強くなる修行を始めたのです~。//
entries.en: It seems the girl was|not human, though...//The problem is what|came after~//His regret was so deep|that he could not rest|in peace~//As a spirit, he took|over a suit of armor|and lingered here~//To get revenge on her,|he began training to|grow stronger~//
entries.note: story p5; 253 words

entries.jp: 成仏はしないわ、|ふくしゅうはするわ、|どこまでもしつこいやつです~。//
entries.en: Won't rest in peace,|goes after revenge...|what a stubborn guy~//
entries.note: story p1; 66 words

entries.jp: でもヨロイって、修行したら|強くなるものなんですか?//
entries.en: But can a suit of|armor get stronger by|training?//
entries.note: story p1; 52 words

entries.jp: はい~。|不思議ですが、そのようです~。//きびしい修行のはてに、|レッドブリキンは人間のころより|数倍強くなりました~。//
entries.en: Yes~|Strange as it is,|it seems so~//After brutal training,|{{HL:0xb001}}Red Brikin{{HL:0xb008}} became|many times stronger~//
entries.note: story p2; 102 words

entries.jp: ですが、その力におぼれて、|村を襲い始めたのです~。//自分の力を見せつけるかのように、|弱い者をいじめ出しました~。//今ではたくさんの部下を引き連れて、|村を支配しています~。//
entries.en: But drunk on that|power, he began|attacking villages~//As if to flaunt his|strength, he started|bullying the weak~//Now he leads many|minions and rules|the villages~//
entries.note: story p3; 166 words

entries.jp: 弱い者いじめは最低ですぅ!|そんなのただのチンピラですぅ!//
entries.en: Bullying the weak is|the lowest! He's just|a common thug!//
entries.note: story p1; 60 words

entries.jp: どうかお願いします、勇者様~。//レッドブリキンを倒して|平和を取り戻してください~。//
entries.en: [spk 0x39a0]Please, I beg you,|dear hero~//Defeat {{HL:0xb001}}Red Brikin{{HL:0xb008}}|and bring back peace~//
entries.note: story p2; 75 words

entries.jp: やっつけましょう、勇者様!//本物の強さってやつを、|その体にたたきこんで|やりましょう!//
entries.en: [spk 0x3b03]Let's take him down,|hero!//Let's pound some|real strength into|that body of his!//
entries.note: story p2; 84 words

entries.jp: まずは村にいる|レッドブリキンの部下を|倒していきましょう!//

entries.en: I see...|I was so vain about|my strength that I//lost perspective.//I forgot my true goal,|and bullying the weak|became my hobby...//...A strange voice.//Ever since I heard|that voice, something|went wrong with me...//
